messages:
Avery M: Heads-up — EmeraldHealth POC needs SOC2 excerpt, ISO cert snippet, and a signed pen-test authorization for their third-party vendor. They want scans against our staging and may ask for a single-tenant dedicated pool. Also asked if we provide short-lived scan creds (S3 presign + temporary SSH). Who is owning the attestation?

Tara S: We can provide redacted SOC2 + ISO27001 cert excerpt + control mapping. Legal signs the pen-test attestation. @Lena J please confirm standard language and whether we can include a brief SLA line about limiting scans to the agreed window.

Lena J: Yes, legal can sign our template. Standard clause: "Testing is limited to agreed scope and timeframe; Redwood Inference is not responsible for findings outside the agreed scope." If customer requests indemnity changes, escalate. Send redlines if any.

Devon H: Operational notes: presigned S3 uploads + timeboxed SSH via jumpbox are our pattern. We never give host-level root creds. If they want dedicated GPUs reserved for the scan that's a burst reservation and costs; also need IP allowlist. If they request VPN into staging, that adds ~1 business day ops.

Avery M: Pricing ask from buyer: estimate for 6h on 3x A100 + ops support.

Devon H: Ballpark: 6h on 3x A100 ~ 0.4x daily dedicated rate => ~$1,300 infra + ~$350 ops = ~$1.65k. Rough estimate only — capacity team can confirm.

Ops Bot: Pre-signed upload created: https://uploads.redwood-inference.com/presign/emerald-1767123456 (expires in 48h). Upload vendor scope + ATO + vendor insurance to /emerald/scan-request/.

Avery M: Action list: 1) Buyer to upload vendor scope + IP list to presign. 2) Lena to stage attestation for signature. 3) Devon to confirm ops cost with capacity team. 4) Ops Bot to provision creds after approvals.

Tara S: I'll message the buyer with the attestation timeline (we can sign standard template within 2 business days after scope) and the preliminary cost estimate. Tagging @Lena J for final wording.

Lena J: Sounds good. If they send redlines, tag me immediately. If they add exec-level indemnity changes we will need approvals.

Avery M: Thanks all — I'll update EmeraldHealth and close once we have scope and IP list. :thumbsup:
